say:0:1029409001:0.text: Magister, the Syndicate seems very vigilant about Illucia's disappearance...
say:0:1029409001:0.source_cn: 主人，黑金商会对于伊露西卡的失踪很谨慎呢……
say:0:1029409001:0.male: Magister, the Syndicate seems very vigilant about Illucia's disappearance...
say:0:1029409001:0.female: Magister, the Syndicate seems very vigilant about Illucia's disappearance...

say:1:1029409002:0.text: And, uh, they mentioned destroying the research materials in the camp near the Sun Temple!
say:1:1029409002:0.source_cn: 还有还有，他们提到要销毁日神殿附近营地的研究资料呢！

say:2:1029409003:0.text: Let's have a look there. I hope we can make it in time.
say:2:1029409003:0.source_cn: 去那边再看看吧，希望赶得及。
say:2:1029409003:0.male: Let's have a look there. I hope we can make it in time.
say:2:1029409003:0.female: Let's have a look there. I hope we can make it in time.
